messages.plaintextBody:
Gregory, Priya,

Completion funds flow attached for sign-off. Sources £46.6m (equity £32.6m + senior £14.0m); applications cover £42.6m to the sellers, £2.0m into escrow, debt payoff, fees and stamp duty. It balances to nil. Please confirm payment instructions for the 27th.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
